versions.title: UI Enhancements and Multi-Account Code Support
improvements: Updated the UI design with a more formal look and simpler, less colorful layout
Improved system to properly process multiple account codes when needed
fixes: Fixed query to handle multiple account codes instead of only one

versions.title: Initial Release of Miscellaneous System
newFeatures: Implemented the Miscellaneous System inside the WSP platform, accessible after user login
Added a dedicated Miscellaneous page for taxpayers
Introduced selectable miscellaneous certificates/services for payment
Added service descriptions and automatic total amount computation
Enabled users to proceed directly to payment from the Miscellaneous module
Integrated SPIDC Universal Checkout payment system
Enabled automatic generation of receipt / EOR (Electronic Official Receipt) after successful payment
improvements: Streamlined navigation from WSP system to Miscellaneous module for faster access
Improved user payment flow with a direct checkout process (reduced steps)
Enhanced clarity of service selection through structured descriptions and pricing display
Improved system integration between Miscellaneous module and SPIDC payment gateway

versions.title: Initial Release of Revised Cedula System
newFeatures: Added Cedula form UI redesigned to mimic the physical cedula form for better familiarity and easier user understanding
Added validation for taxpayer input including birthdate restriction (minimum age 15 years old)
improvements: Improved Cedula issuance form layout for better usability and clarity
Improved tax computation and payment calculation process for accuracy
Improved treasury transaction management layout to match the taxpayer-side form design for consistency
Improved transaction filtering and search functionality for better record handling and navigation
fixes: Fixed tax computation and payment calculation issues
Fixed payment redirection issue to Universal Checkout
Fixed transaction count glitch that changes over time
Fixed rendering issue where pending and successful transactions were not properly separated
Fixed edit, approve, and reject functionality in treasury module
Fixed remarks handling so it only appears under approved or rejected transactions
Fixed filtering and search inconsistencies in treasury transactions
